name: Debug Mode
title: Watch your thoughts go by and label what triggered each.
subtitle: Thought Tracing
rationale: Naming the trigger behind each thought interrupts anxious loops without requiring a formal meditation practice.
origin: Naval Ravikant describes running his mind in debug mode.

evidence.summary: Parallels cognitive-defusion techniques with clinical support; Naval's framing makes it land for engineers.

sources.label: Naval Ravikant on the Knowledge Project

indications: The same mental loops replay through routine tasks.
Seated meditation has been tried and abandoned more than once.
